title: Handelin inhibits osteoclastogenesis and bone loss by targeting lipocalin-2 and restoring autophagy to suppress NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: Hu, Shian; Li, Junhong; Zhang, Yayun; Li, Jianwen; Wang, Shiheng; Mou, Yan; Liu, Jian; Sun, Xuying; Hu, Peixuan; Kang, Honglei; Zhu, Meipeng
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Handelin通过靶向LCN2和自噬抑制NF-κB信号来阻断破骨细胞生成，属于骨代谢疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Excessive osteoclastogenesis is a pivotal pathological process in osteoporosis. Identifying compounds that can effectively inhibit osteoclastogenesis without toxicity is of great therapeutic interest. Handelin, a guaianolide dimer from Chrysanthemum indicum and other Chrysanthemum spp., possesses known anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, yet its role in osteoclastogenesis remains unclear. This study aims to investigate the role and mechanism of Handelin in osteoclastogenesis. METHODS: The effects of Handelin on osteoclast differentiation and function were assessed using Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8), tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase (TRAP) and F-actin ring staining, bone pit assays, real-time quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR), and western blot in vitro. An ovariectomized (OVX) mouse model was employed for in vivo validation, evaluated by Micro-CT, histological staining, and ELISA assays. RNA sequencing (RNA-seq), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) analysis, molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), co-immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence, and autophagy flux assays were employed for mechanistic investigation. Rescue experiments were conducted using recombinant lipocalin-2 (rLCN2) protein and sequestosome-1 (p62) overexpression. RESULTS: Handelin potently inhibited RANKL-induced osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption in vitro without cytotoxicity and alleviated OVX-induced bone loss in vivo. RNA-seq revealed Handelin downregulated LCN2 and activated autophagy while inhibiting the NF-kappaB pathway. Handelin directly bounded LCN2, reduced its expression at both mRNA and protein levels in cells and tissues, and restored autophagic flux, weakening the interaction between p62-TRAF6 to block NF-kappaB signaling. The anti-osteoclastogenic effects of Handelin were partially reversed by rLCN2 supplementation or p62 overexpression. Notably, Handelin did not impair osteogenic differentiation. CONCLUSION: This study identifies Handelin as a novel inhibitor of osteoclastogenesis that targets the LCN2-autophagy pathway and suppresses NF-kappaB signaling, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic agent for osteoporosis and related bone diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：过度破骨细胞生成（osteoclastogenesis）是骨质疏松症中的一个关键病理过程。寻找能够有效抑制破骨细胞生成且无毒的化合物具有重要的治疗意义。Handelin，一种来自野菊花（Chrysanthemum indicum）及其他菊属（Chrysanthemum spp.）植物的愈创木内酯二聚体，具有已知的抗炎和抗氧化特性，但其在破骨细胞生成中的作用尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨Handelin在破骨细胞生成中的作用及其机制。方法：通过细胞计数试剂盒-8（CCK-8）、抗酒石酸酸性磷酸酶（TRAP）和F-actin环染色、骨陷窝实验、实时定量PCR（RT-qPCR）和蛋白质印迹法在体外评估Handelin对破骨细胞分化和功能的影响。采用去卵巢（OVX）小鼠模型进行体内验证，通过Micro-CT、组织学染色和ELISA检测评估。机制研究采用RNA测序（RNA-seq）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和基因集富集分析（GSEA）、分子对接、表面等离子体共振（SPR）、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、免疫共沉淀、免疫荧光和自噬通量检测。使用重组脂质运载蛋白-2（rLCN2）蛋白和sequestosome-1（p62）过表达进行拯救实验。结果：Handelin在体外有效抑制RANKL诱导的破骨细胞分化和骨吸收，且无细胞毒性，并在体内缓解OVX诱导的骨丢失。RNA-seq显示Handelin下调LCN2并激活自噬，同时抑制NF-kappaB通路。Handelin直接结合LCN2，在细胞和组织中降低其mRNA和蛋白水平，并恢复自噬通量，削弱p62-TRAF6之间的相互作用以阻断NF-kappaB信号传导。Handelin的抗破骨细胞生成作用可被rLCN2补充或p62过表达部分逆转。值得注意的是，Handelin不损害成骨分化。结论：本研究将Handelin鉴定为一种靶向LCN2-自噬通路并抑制NF-kappaB信号传导的新型破骨细胞生成抑制剂，突显其作为骨质疏松症及相关骨病治疗药物的潜力。
